title: Cardinal Billing Account Standing Rule: Notice Surcharge on the Renewal Down Payment Percentage
content:
**Rule.** A notice surcharge is added to the renewal down payment percentage of a Cardinal Billing Account: **10 percentage points** when a notice of cancellation for nonpayment was mailed on the account in the last 12 whole months, **5 percentage points** when none was mailed in the last 12 whole months but one was mailed in the last 24 whole months, and none otherwise.

A window of the last 12 or 24 whole months holds every record posted less than that many whole months before the bill date (the renewal bill date), counted on calendar months. The notices counted are the notices of cancellation for nonpayment recorded on the account's billing history, whether or not they were later rescinded.

| Notice in the last 12 whole months | Notice in the last 24 whole months | Notice surcharge |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 10 percentage points |
| No | Yes | 5 percentage points |
| No | No | None |

**Hypothetical cases.** A notice recorded 8 whole months before the bill date: 10 percentage points. A single notice recorded 18 whole months before the bill date: 5 percentage points. A single notice recorded 30 whole months before: none.
